description: This file defines the CompatActionBarNavHandler class which implements tab and navigation listeners to handle action bar navigation events in an Android application, relaying events to a specified listener.

classes.name: CompatActionBarNavHandler
classes.description: Adapter class that implements tab and navigation listeners to handle Android action bar navigation events and relay them to a configured listener.

methods.name: CompatActionBarNavHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with a navigation listener.

methods.name: onTabSelected
methods.description: Handles tab selection events by notifying the listener with the selected tab position.

methods.name: onNavigationItemSelected
methods.description: Handles navigation menu item selection and notifies the listener with the selected item position.

methods.name: onTabReselected
methods.description: Handles re-selected tab events; no action needed in this implementation.

methods.name: onTabUnselected
methods.description: Handles tab unselection events; no action needed in this implementation.
